# 2 Baruch Chapter 73 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "When he has subdued everything in the world and has settled in peace forever on the throne of his kingdom, joy will be revealed and rest will come."

**2** "Healing will fall like dew; disease will vanish; anxiety, anguish, and lamentation will disappear from among people; and gladness will spread throughout the whole earth."

**3** "No one will die before their time, and no sudden calamity will come upon anyone."

**4** "Violence and abuse, strife and revenge, bloodshed and passion, envy and hatred — all these things will be condemned, for they are what has filled the world with evil."

**5** "Wild animals will come out of the forest and serve human beings; vipers and serpents will emerge from their dens and submit to a little child."

**6** "Women will no longer suffer pain in childbirth, and they will not be tormented when they bring forth children."

**7** "In those days the harvesters will not grow tired and the builders will not be worn out; for the work will advance swiftly by itself, together with those who do it, in every blessing."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
